datasets.activity_name: computer production, desktop, without screen
datasets.reference_product: computer, desktop, without screen
datasets.product_information: This is an infrastructure, representing the product of a desktop computer, without screen.  Its production represents a typical desktop computer used at home or in an office (Pentium 4, processor speed 2000 MHz, 40 GB RAM HDD, 512 MB working memory, total weight without screen and cardboard packaging 11.3 kg). Computer parts like Graphic card, Network card, Hard disk drive, CD Rom drive, Power supply unit, Printed wiring boards (e.g. motherboard) and batteries are inventoried in individual datasets.

datasets.activity_name: market group for electricity, medium voltage
datasets.reference_product: electricity, medium voltage
datasets.product_information: This product represents electrical energy measured in kWh. If electricity is taken from a market for electricity, the transmission infrastructure, country-specific losses and transformation losses (for markets for medium and low voltage) are included. Covers voltages between 1kV and 24 kV.

datasets.activity_name: integrated circuit production, logic type
datasets.reference_product: integrated circuit, logic type
datasets.product_information: This is an electric component usually soldered to a printed wiring board (PWB) in electronic circuits. Integrated circuits are electronic circuits etched in a semiconducting material (usually silicon) by photolithography and enclosed in a package to protect the circuit. Logic type circuits perform specified logical operations on incoming data.

datasets.activity_name: transistor production, surface-mounted
datasets.reference_product: transistor, surface-mounted
datasets.product_information: This is an electric component usually soldered to a printed wiring board (PWB) in electronic circuits. Transistors are made of semiconductor material and are used to switch or amplify electric signals. For this product it is assumed that a typical SMD transistor in electronic modules has an average weight of 0.593 g. This component is designed for surface mounting.

datasets.activity_name: electronic component production, active, unspecified
datasets.reference_product: electronic component, active, unspecified
datasets.product_information: This product represents an unweighted average between the following datasets of active components: diodes, transistors and integrated circuits. It is intended to be used as a rough proxy for active components, if no further data is available.

datasets.activity_name: printed wiring board production, mounted mainboard, desktop computer, Pb free
datasets.reference_product: printed wiring board, mounted mainboard, desktop computer, Pb free
datasets.product_information: This product represents 1 kg of a mounted printed wiring board (also printed circuit board) also called mainboard (motherboard) in a desktop computer. The product is a mounted printed wiring board, meaning the electronic components such as capacitors, resistors, integrated circuits etc. have been soldered to the board. The solder and surface used for mounting the components is lead free.

datasets.reference_product: cable, ribbon cable, 20-pin, with plugs
datasets.product_information: This product represents a typical 20-way ribbon cable used to connect drives to a computer. It includes all materials necessary to construct it and energy consumption during manufacturing.

datasets.activity_name: electric connector production, peripheral component interconnect buss
datasets.reference_product: electric connector, peripheral component interconnect buss
datasets.product_information: This product represents an internal connector for computer technology, i.e. the so-called Peripheral Component Interconnect (PCI) bus. It is used to connect devices to the motherboard of a computer.

datasets.activity_name: computer production, laptop
datasets.reference_product: computer, laptop
datasets.product_information: This  is an infrastructure, representing the product of a laptop computer. Its production represents a typical laptop computer in the last 3 years before the reference year 2005 (Pentium 3) with a processor speed 600 MHz, 10 GB RAM, 128 MB memory, 12.1 inch screen, and a total mass with expansion base 3.15 kg. The expansion base is included without speaker, switch and cables.  Its production represents all materials necessary to construct it and energy consumption during manufacturing.

datasets.activity_name: integrated circuit production, memory type
datasets.reference_product: integrated circuit, memory type
datasets.product_information: This is an electric component usually soldered to a printed wiring board (PWB) in electronic circuits. Integrated circuits are electronic circuits etched in a semiconducting material (usually silicon) by photolithography and enclosed in a package to protect the circuit. Memory type circuits store and give back data in the same form in which it is entered.

datasets.activity_name: fan production, for power supply unit, desktop computer
datasets.reference_product: fan, for power supply unit, desktop computer
datasets.product_information: This products represents 1 unit of a fan for a power supply unit (PSU) of a typical Desktop PC. It is based on a brushless rotary DC fan (12V, 0.15A).

datasets.activity_name: power supply unit production, for desktop computer
datasets.reference_product: power supply unit, for desktop computer
datasets.product_information: This is an infrastructure, representing the product of a power supply unit that is used to supply a desktop computer. It represents the production and assembly of one unit of a power supply unit (PSU) of a typical Desktop PC, based on a Switching Power Supply unit, model ST-235ATX, from the Chinese producer PC Winner. The process includes needed material inputs for the construction of the product, while it excludes energy, emissions and waste.

datasets.activity_name: hard disk drive production, for desktop computer
datasets.reference_product: hard disk drive, for desktop computer
datasets.product_information: This is an infrastructure, representing the product of a Hard Disk for a desktop computer. Its production represents a common hard disk drive used in the last 3 years before 2005, Model "Western Digital", IDE hard drive, 10 GB, with a total mass 0.575 kg.  Its includes all the materials necessary to construct it, energy consumption during manufacturing.

datasets.activity_name: corrugated board box production
datasets.reference_product: corrugated board box
datasets.product_information: The product 'corrugated board box' represents a box made of corrugated board. Corrugated board consist of different types of containerboards, namely linerboard and fluting medium. Linerboard is a flat layer of board, which can be further distinguished in kraftliner and testliner, depending on whether it is of virgin or recycled origin, respectively. Fluting medium is the corrugated middle layer between a top and bottom layer of linerboard. Together all three layers constitute corrugated board. To produce corrugated board boxes, the corrugated board is cut into sheets, printed, slotted, folded, and glued. Corrugated board boxes are used for the packaging of products for protection and transportation.
